method: All eight actual PNG files were opened with view_image(detail=original) and displayed to the reviewer; dimensions and hashes below come from the original bytes.

reviewedPaths.observation: Nested confirmation, current/proposed slug and reason are readable; Cancel focus is visible and both actions fit the narrow panel.
The retained proposal and reason remain in the labelled fields after closing/reopening; close control has visible focus.
Entered objective is present. Unavailable and unconfirmed messages agree; retry is offered without a saved acknowledgement.
Newer objective remains visible and the form explicitly says changes are not saved, despite the prior server revision acknowledgement.
The local and server productions are distinguished, comparison text is readable and rebase/reload actions fit and wrap.
Session expiry is explicit; retained fields, inactive saving, copy and reconnect choices remain readable.
A generic resource-not-found view appears, with catalogue return and no private project title or production.
The HTML-shaped fixture is displayed as literal text, not an image; missing English translation is stated explicitly.

findings.state: Acknowledged; separate minimal fix and targeted post-fix workshop checks planned by root
findings.description: Project back and help links are visually adjacent without spacing in the workshop captures. No product change was made by this reviewer.
